message.reasoning: We need to answer from policy excerpts. The question: "Is the response-time clock paused on weekends and holidays, or does it run continuously regardless of business hours?" According to DOC-042 part 1: By default, the response-time metric counts every hour a ticket sits unanswered, including nights, weekends and holidays — it is a wall-clock measurement, not a business-hours one. So answer: It runs continuously. Also mention that you can configure business hours to exclude time. So answer accordingly.
